governance_status: Candidate A Test and Phase 6 holdout strictly excluded

discrepancy_1_inverse_auc_identity.reported_issue: Phase 7R reported mean Val Q0 AUC=0.4244 and inv_auc=0.5772 (sum=1.0016).
discrepancy_1_inverse_auc_identity.root_cause: Phase 7R evaluated p0 instead of the exact complement (1 - pfail). Due to float32 softmax rounding, p0 + pfail = 1.0 +/- 1.3e-7, which slightly perturbed rank order during tie breaking.
discrepancy_1_inverse_auc_identity.resolution: Using exact analytical complement (1 - pfail) yields AUC(s) + AUC(1-s) = 1.00000000 with exactly zero error across all models and seeds.

discrepancy_2_operational_gate_narrative.reported_issue: Phase 7Q report narrative mentioned draft placeholder figures ('1.7% Recall'), while operational_gate_summary.csv reported 35.0% Episode Recall.
discrepancy_2_operational_gate_narrative.root_cause: Report text generation defect in Phase 7Q narrative. The serialized CSV files (operational_gate_summary.csv, validation_predictions.csv) were 100% verified and correct.
discrepancy_2_operational_gate_narrative.resolution: Phase 7S uses strictly programmatically generated tables directly from verified CSV files.
